title: Issue with Search Box using NG4
body:
I am following the exact documentation, however, whenever I type in the search box I am seeing the following error:

### SearchBoxComponent.html:5 ERROR TypeError: this.state.refine is not a function
    at SearchBoxComponent.handleChange (search-box.component.ts:27)
    at Object.eval [as handleEvent] (SearchBoxComponent.html:5)
    at handleEvent (core.es5.js:11998)
    at callWithDebugContext (core.es5.js:13467)
    at Object.debugHandleEvent [as handleEvent] (core.es5.js:13055)
    at dispatchEvent (core.es5.js:8614)
    at eval (core.es5.js:9228)
    at HTMLInputElement.eval (platform-browser.es5.js:2648)
    at ZoneDelegate.invokeTask (zone.js:425)
    at Object.onInvokeTask (core.es5.js:3881)

It is from the handleChange function that gets called but all of this is per the documentation so a bit lost as to why it is not working.
